title: [v0.92.1][V3-F] Repair Sprint 5/6 cutover blockers
body:
Closes #596
Part-Of #505
Part-Of #534

This PR packages the bounded Sprint 5/6 cutover-review remediation branch without making C-SDLC v3 live authority.

Changes:
- Restores the remediation branch to a v3-separate scope: no net `csdlc-v2/**` source or test mutation remains in the PR diff.
- Repairs #596 lifecycle truth so the PR visibly closes #596 while keeping #505/#534 as non-closing links.
- Strengthens the issue-owned validator to fail if the branch mutates `csdlc-v2/**`, loses six-card issue state, loses visible `Closes #596`, or accidentally closes #505/#534.
- Brings the v3 full replacement denominator and real-issue canaries onto this remediation branch, proving v3 is still incomplete for #505 cutover while exercising current #596 and terminal #4646 records.
- Keeps duplicate-publication and PR #612 supersession evidence captured as replacement/cutover defects instead of repairing them by changing v2 source.

Validation:
- `bash .csdlc/prepared/issues/596/validate-remediation-regression.sh`
- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --test real_issue_canary`
- `cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `git diff --check`

Non-claims:
- Leaves issue #505 open; no v3 authority cutover, v2 retirement, merge, finish, or cleanup authority is claimed by this PR.
- Does not implement or modify C-SDLC v2 behavior; v2 remains live authority until #505 cutover.
head: codex/sprints-5-6-cutover-fixes
